notes: Flagged large-source unit `בַּעַל כָּנָף` → *bird* retained: one English word carries both morphemes' senses and writes neither lexeme separately, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is met and rule 23's syntactic-head sentence puts the head on the governing construct.
`בְּעֵינֵי` is not fused here: the ASV spends *In* on the preposition and *the sight* on the construct noun, so rule 30's condition is unmet and rule 2 splits them.
The phrase's single *of* stands immediately before *any*, so it is the relation of the outer chain and belongs to `כֹּל` as its rectum; the inner chain `בַּעַל כָּנָף` has no *of* written for it.
